verses.pali: Atha kho udāyī brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā …pe… ekamantaṁ nisinno kho udāyī brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Then Udāyī the brahmin went up to the Buddha, … and asked him,

verses.pali: “Na kho ahaṁ, brāhmaṇa, sabbaṁ yaññaṁ vaṇṇemi;
na panāhaṁ, brāhmaṇa, sabbaṁ yaññaṁ na vaṇṇemi.
verses.english: Nor do I criticize all sacrifices. …

verses.pali: Yathārūpe kho, brāhmaṇa, yaññe gāvo haññanti, ajeḷakā haññanti, kukkuṭasūkarā haññanti, vividhā pāṇā saṅghātaṁ āpajjanti;
verses.english: Take the kind of sacrifice where cattle, goats and sheep, chickens and pigs, and various kinds of animals are slaughtered.

verses.pali: evarūpaṁ kho ahaṁ, brāhmaṇa, sārambhaṁ yaññaṁ na vaṇṇemi.
verses.english: I don’t praise that kind of violent sacrifice.

verses.pali: Evarūpañhi, brāhmaṇa, sārambhaṁ yaññaṁ na upasaṅkamanti arahanto vā arahattamaggaṁ vā samāpannā.
Yathārūpe ca kho, brāhmaṇa, yaññe neva gāvo haññanti, na ajeḷakā haññanti, na kukkuṭasūkarā haññanti, na vividhā pāṇā saṅghātaṁ āpajjanti;
verses.english: But take the kind of sacrifice where cattle, goats and sheep, chickens and pigs, and various kinds of animals are not slaughtered.

verses.pali: evarūpaṁ kho ahaṁ, brāhmaṇa, nirārambhaṁ yaññaṁ vaṇṇemi, yadidaṁ niccadānaṁ anukulayaññaṁ.
verses.english: I do praise that kind of non-violent sacrifice; for example, a regular gift as an propitious sacrifice.

verses.pali: Evarūpañhi, brāhmaṇa, nirārambhaṁ yaññaṁ upasaṅkamanti arahanto vā arahattamaggaṁ vā samāpannāti.

verses.english: a sacrifice that’s allowable and timely,
The Buddhas—<j>who have drawn back the veil from the world,
as they are expert in sacrifice.
When you’ve prepared a suitable offering,
whether as sacrifice or for ancestors,
in the fertile field of spiritual practitioners.
to those worthy of a religious donation,
and even the deities are pleased.
sacrifices like this, with a mind of letting go,
